column1: # The array homes, one fixture row each, a newline written as \n
# (base#1443): path, numbered prefix, the writers' all-empty entry, the
# populated entry, the every-field-empty entry, and who writes the home.
# A `writer` row is one the shell writers name (_conf_toml_aot_section
# over SCHEMA_SECTIONS, dist/script/docker/lib/conf.sh), in their order;
# its all-empty entry is _conf_toml_aot_fields of "" and its populated
# carries every field its family reads (the bridge's _ARRAY_SPEC third
# and fourth elements, in that order), each empty (base#1443 review
# round 4 finding 2). The `legacy` row is the one-array `[[devices]]`
